summary: Iteration 97 - Quotation→SO Prefill + MTS/MTO Redesign. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: 'From Quotation' dropdown, quotation search, BOM prefill, customer linking, balance tracking, and source quotation badge in SO list all working correctly.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning)

seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary items, BOMs, customers, quotations, and SOs with TEST_ prefix, then clean up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quotation→SO prefill feature fully tested. Key test fixture: QUO-000023-R1 (id=4ca28139-2419-496b-b5dc-bb3a3b5f4d1f) with FG-001 item and BOM 75144c12-cdcd-4e85-abbe-c177b1762132. MTS/MTO confirm flow verified: MTS ignores FG stock (mo_qty=full qty), MTO uses FG stock first (reserved_qty=min(qty, stock), mo_qty=remainder). Child reservations on MO creation and release on SO cancel verified.

backend.description: GET /api/crm/quotations/{qid}/balance returns per-line balance with item/bom hydration and customer info
POST /api/production with source_quotation_id creates SO, increments quotation consumed_qty, decrements balance
Partial conversion (consume < total qty): quotation status stays draft/sent, balance > 0, converted_so_ids appended
Full conversion (sum of all SOs == quotation line qty): quotation status flips to 'converted', converted_so_id set, converted_at set
Cancelling a sourced SO via POST /api/production/{id}/cancel restores the balance (cancelled SOs excluded from consumed_qty)
MTS line sets reserved_qty=0 and mo_qty=quantity (ignoring FG stock entirely)
MTO line reserves min(qty, FG free stock) and produces MO for the remainder
Legacy SOs with order_type='auto' normalize to 'mts' on create
When MO is created, child SG/parts get reserved_stock incremented by required qty
When SO is cancelled, child reserved_stock decrements back (no orphan reservations)
GET /api/production returns source_quotation_no for SOs created from quotations

frontend.test: From Quotation block in Create SO dialog
frontend.description: data-testid='so-from-quotation-block' present with search input and dropdown
Search by quotation no/customer shows matching quotations with status badges
Selecting QUO-000023-R1 prefills BOM (FG-001), qty (10), due date, order type (MTS)
Clear link button restores quotation search input

frontend.test: Source quotation badge in SO list
frontend.description: SO list shows 'from QUO-...' badge under order number for SOs created from quotations
Selecting quotation with no BOM-attached items shows error toast and does NOT prefill

features_verified.quotation_balance_endpoint: GET /api/crm/quotations/{qid}/balance returns per-line balance with item/bom hydration
features_verified.so_from_quotation: POST /api/production with source_quotation_id creates SO and tracks consumed_qty
features_verified.partial_conversion: Quotation status stays draft/sent until all lines fully consumed
features_verified.full_conversion: Quotation auto-marks 'converted' when every line balance reaches 0

features_verified.mts_confirm: MTS ignores FG stock, always produces full SO qty via MO
features_verified.mto_confirm: MTO uses available FG stock first, MO only for shortfall
